# bioexcel/biobb_amber/sander_mdrun

## Summary

Wrapper of the AmberTools (AMBER MD Package) sander tool module.

Runs energy minimization, molecular dynamics, and NMR refinements using sander tool from the AmberTools MD package.

Nextflow adapter of the [SanderMDRun](https://biobb-amber.readthedocs.io/en/latest/sander.html#module-sander.sander_mdrun) building block of [biobb_amber](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_amber) 5.3.3.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_AMBER_SANDER_MDRUN } from 'bioexcel/biobb_amber/sander_mdrun'

workflow {
    BIOBB_AMBER_SANDER_MDRUN(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_top_path` | yes | top, parmtop, prmtop | Input topology file (AMBER ParmTop) |
| `input_crd_path` | yes | crd, mdcrd, inpcrd, netcdf, nc, ncrst, rst | Input coordinates file (AMBER crd) |
| `input_mdin_path` | no | mdin, in, txt | Input configuration file (MD run options) (AMBER mdin) |
| `input_cpin_path` | no | cpin | Input constant pH file (AMBER cpin) |
| `input_ref_path` | no | rst, rst7, netcdf, nc, ncrst, crd | Input reference coordinates for position restraints |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_log_path` | yes | log, out, txt, o | Output log file |
| `output_traj_path` | yes | trj, crd, mdcrd, x, netcdf, nc | Output trajectory file |
| `output_rst_path` | yes | rst, rst7, netcdf, nc, ncrst | Output restart file |
| `output_cpout_path` | no, opt-in | cpout | Output constant pH file (AMBER cpout) |
| `output_cprst_path` | no, opt-in | cprst, rst, rst7 | Output constant pH restart file (AMBER rstout) |
| `output_mdinfo_path` | no, opt-in | mdinfo | Output MD info |
| `versions_biobb_amber` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_amber', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of SanderMDRun properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_cpout_path: 'cpout']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_amber container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_AMBER_SANDER_MDRUN' {
        ext.properties = [simulation_type: 'minimization']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mdin` | object | {} | Sander MD run options specification. (Used if *input_mdin_path* is None) |
| `simulation_type` | string | "minimization" | Default options for the mdin file. Each creates a different mdin file. Values: minimization, min_vacuo, NVT, npt, free, heat. |
| `binary_path` | string | "sander" | sander binary path to be used. |
| `direct_mdin` | boolean | false | Use input_mdin_path as it is, skip file parsing. |
| `mpi_bin` | string | null | Path to the MPI runner. Usually "mpirun" or "srun". |
| `mpi_np` | integer | 0 | Number of MPI processes. Usually an integer bigger than 1. |
| `mpi_flags` | string | null | Path to the MPI hostlist file. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
